steps.label: Find an adhesive bandage
steps.text: Take an adhesive bandage from the top-left compartment. Look for its light; if it stays off, use the screen location. Tell me when you have it; we'll rinse the cut before covering it.

steps.label: Rinse the superficial cut
steps.text: If running tap water or sterile saline is available, rinse this superficial cut until no visible debris remains. Tell me when you're done.

steps.label: Cover the clean cut
steps.text: Once the superficial cut is clean, cover it with the adhesive bandage. Tell me if you need anything else.
